production.direction_en: At a fork in the stair, companions who escorted refugees return from the outer route. They do not replace the player's formation; they create a brief, scripted diversion while the five-person party advances.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_held_the_road — full ensemble statement | post: bgm_held_the_road (comic tag for the barricade line)

commands.speaker: rikka_ember
commands.text: Outer stair is held! Mostly because my barricade is now on fire, but held is held.

commands.speaker: marek_vane
commands.text: The road is ours. Go finish what we began.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: When this is over, I want to hear every detail of that barricade.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: When this is over. I will keep borrowing those words until there are none left.
